title: Key West Dolphin Tour & Snorkeling- Small Group
includes: Four Winns 25 foot motor boat, noodles & flotation devices, fresh water shower after snorkeling
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Featured in National Geographic Travel - Over 2000 five-star reviews and ranked #1 on Google Maps for Key West dolphin tours.
Small Groups, Big Experience - Maximum 6 guests on comfortable Four Winns (25ft) or Robalo (25ft) boats. Enjoy unobstructed dolphin views and personalized attention from USCG-licensed captains.
95% Dolphin Success Rate - Our captains know these waters after 20 years. While wild dolphin sightings aren't guaranteed, our track record speaks for itself.
Premium Comfort - Full rooftop shade, open bow for sunbathing, ample storage, onboard restroom, and complimentary refreshments.
Flexible Policy - Minimum 3 passengers required. If not met, we offer private charter conversion (add one ticket), reschedule, or full refund.
Daily Departures - Perry Hotel Marina, Stock Island with free parking. Times vary seasonally for optimal conditions.
